tool.name: get_address
tool.title: Address information
tool.description:
Balance and transaction counts. Supports P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, P2TR and P2A addresses, and P2PK public keys in hex (33 or 65 bytes).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}`.

Address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_address_confirmed_txs
tool.title: Address confirmed transactions
tool.description:
Get the newest confirmed transactions for an address, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most). For pagination, request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` with the last returned txid.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-chain)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain`.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 25 (the default); larger values return 25.

Address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_address_confirmed_txs_after
tool.title: Address confirmed transactions (paginated)
tool.description:
Get the next confirmed transactions strictly older than `after_txid`, up to `max_txs` (25 by default and at most); a txid outside the address's history answers `[]` (Esplora-canonical pagination form, matches mempool.space).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-chain)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}`.

after_txid.description: Last txid from the previous page (return transactions strictly older than this)

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 25 (the default); larger values return 25.

Address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_address_hash_prefix_matches
tool.title: Address hash-prefix matches
tool.description:
Find addresses by address type and by the first 1-16 hex nibbles of RapidHash v3 over the raw address payload bytes. Intended for privacy-preserving client-side wallet discovery without sending raw addresses or xpubs. Fetch metadata with `GET /api/address/{address}`.

REST operation: `GET /api/address/hash-prefix/{address_type}/{prefix}`.

prefix.description:
First 1–16 hexadecimal nibbles of the RapidHash v3 hash over the raw
address payload bytes.

AddressOutputType.description: The output type of an address: any output type but `p2ms`, `op_return`, `empty_script` and `unknown_script`.

tool.name: get_address_mempool_txs
tool.title: Address mempool transactions
tool.description:
Get unconfirmed transactions for an address from the mempool, newest first, up to `max_txs` (50 by default and at most).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-mempool)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/mempool`.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 50 (the default); larger values return 50.

Address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_address_txs
tool.title: Address transactions
tool.description:
Get transaction history for an address, newest first: up to `max_txs` (50 by default and at most), mempool transactions first and confirmed ones filling the rest. To continue, pass the last returned txid as `after_txid`, or request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` for confirmed history.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs`.

after_txid.description:
Continue after this transaction, a mempool or a confirmed one: the older ones (a confirmed
cursor skips the mempool). One that is neither answers 422.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 50 (the default); larger values return 50.

Address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_address_utxos
tool.title: Address UTXOs
tool.description:
Get unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) for an address, including unconfirmed ones; outputs that mempool transactions spend are left out.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-utxo)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/utxo`.

Address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

tool.name: get_block
tool.title: Block information
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_by_timestamp
tool.title: Block by timestamp
tool.description:
Find the block with the greatest header timestamp at or before the given UNIX timestamp, choosing the earliest height on ties.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-timestamp)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/timestamp/{timestamp}`.

tool.name: get_block_fee_rates
tool.title: Block fee rates
tool.description:
Get block fee rate percentiles (min, 10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th, max) for a time period, each a whole sat/vB (`/precise` for 3 decimals).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-feerates)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/fee-rates/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_block_fee_rates_precise
tool.title: Block fee rates (precise)
tool.description:
Get block fee rate percentiles (min, 10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th, max) for a time period, each in sat/vB to 3 decimals.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-feerates)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/fee-rates/{time_period}/precise`.

tool.name: get_block_fees
tool.title: Block fees
tool.description:
Get average total fees per block for a time period.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-fees)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/fees/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_block_hash_by_height
tool.title: Block hash by height
tool.description:
Block hash as plain text.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-height)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block-height/{height}`.

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_block_header
tool.title: Block header
tool.description:
Returns the hex-encoded 80-byte block header.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-header)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/header`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_rewards
tool.title: Block rewards
tool.description:
Get average coinbase reward (subsidy + fees) per block for a time period.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-rewards)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/rewards/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_block_sizes_weights
tool.title: Block sizes and weights
tool.description:
Get average block sizes and weights for a time period.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-sizes-weights)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/sizes-weights/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_block_status
tool.title: Block status
tool.description:
Whether the block is in the best chain and, if so, its height and the hash of the next block. A block outside the best chain (orphaned or unknown) reports `in_best_chain: false`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-status)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/status`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_tip_hash
tool.title: Block tip hash
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-tip-hash)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks/tip/hash`.

tool.name: get_block_tip_height
tool.title: Block tip height
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-tip-height)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks/tip/height`.

tool.name: get_block_txid
tool.title: Transaction ID at index
tool.description:
Retrieve a single transaction ID at a specific index within a block. Returns plain text txid.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transaction-id)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/txid/{index}`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

BlockTxIndex.description:
Position of a transaction within a single block (0 = coinbase).
Distinct from `TxIndex`, which is the chain-wide global tx index.

tool.name: get_block_txs_from_index
tool.title: Block transactions (paginated)
tool.description:
Up to 25 transactions starting at `start_index`, a multiple of 25.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transactions)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/txs/{start_index}`.

start_index.description: Starting transaction index within the block (0-based)

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

BlockTxIndex.description:
Position of a transaction within a single block (0 = coinbase).
Distinct from `TxIndex`, which is the chain-wide global tx index.

tool.name: get_block_v1
tool.title: Block (v1)
tool.description:
Returns block details with extras by hash.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-v1)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/block/{hash}`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_blocks
tool.title: Recent blocks
tool.description:
The last 10 blocks.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks`.

tool.name: get_blocks_from_height
tool.title: Blocks from height
tool.description:
Retrieve up to 10 blocks going backwards from the given height. For example, height=100 returns blocks 100, 99, 98, ..., 91. Height=0 returns only block 0. A height past the tip is not found.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks/{height}`.

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_blocks_v1
tool.title: Recent blocks with extras
tool.description:
Retrieve the last 15 blocks with extended data including pool identification and fee statistics.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks-v1)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/blocks`.

tool.name: get_blocks_v1_from_height
tool.title: Blocks from height with extras
tool.description:
Retrieve up to 15 blocks with extended data going backwards from the given height: the published blocks among the 15 heights ending at it, so fewer (or none) past the tip.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks-v1)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/blocks/{height}`.

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

tool.name: get_cpfp
tool.title: CPFP info
tool.description:
Returns ancestors and descendants for a CPFP (Child Pays For Parent) transaction, including the effective fee rate of the package. A mempool transaction answers its live package; a confirmed one its package among its block's transactions; an unknown transaction, or a confirmed one without relatives in its block, `{"ancestors":[]}`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-children-pay-for-parent)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/cpfp/{txid}`.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustment
tool.title: Difficulty adjustment
tool.description:
Get current difficulty adjustment progress and estimates.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustment)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/difficulty-adjustment`.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustments
tool.title: Difficulty adjustments (all time)
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustments)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/difficulty-adjustments`.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustments_by_period
tool.title: Difficulty adjustments
tool.description:
Get historical difficulty adjustments for a time period.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustments)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/difficulty-adjustments/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_fullrbf_replacements
tool.title: Recent full-RBF replacements
tool.description:
Same response shape as `GET /api/v1/replacements`, but limited to trees where at least one predecessor was non-signaling (full-RBF).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-fullrbf-replacements)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/fullrbf/replacements`.

tool.name: get_hashrate
tool.title: Network hashrate (all time)
tool.description:
Get network hashrate and difficulty data for all time.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-hashrate)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate`.

tool.name: get_hashrate_by_period
tool.title: Network hashrate
tool.description:
Get network hashrate and difficulty data for a time period.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-hashrate)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_historical_price
tool.title: Historical price
tool.description:
Completed four-hour BTC/USD closes, newest first as mempool.space lists them, labeled by interval end, from the first priced interval (2010-08-16). With a UNIX timestamp, returns the latest nonempty completed close at or before it; before the first close returns an empty list. The current partial interval is excluded. USD only (`currency` accepts `USD`); exchangeRates is empty.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-historical-price)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/historical-price`.

timestamp.description: UNIX timestamp: the latest close at or before it

currency.description: Quote currency: USD, the only one served

Currency.description: A quote currency prices are served in: USD only.

tool.name: get_mempool
tool.title: Mempool statistics
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool)*

REST operation: `GET /api/mempool`.

tool.name: get_mempool_blocks
tool.title: Projected mempool blocks
tool.description:
Projected blocks for fee estimation. Block 0 reflects Bitcoin Core's actual next-block selection; blocks 1+ are a fee-tier approximation.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool-blocks-fees)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/fees/mempool-blocks`.

tool.name: get_mempool_recent
tool.title: Recent mempool transactions
tool.description:
Get the last 10 transactions to enter the mempool.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool-recent)*

REST operation: `GET /api/mempool/recent`.

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_outputs
tool.title: Output value histogram at height or day
tool.description:
Unfiltered output value histogram for a confirmed point. A block height (`840000`) counts that block's nonzero outputs within the histogram's bin range, coinbase included, by value on the oracle log scale; a calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) sums every block that day. A flat array of log-scale bins.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/outputs/{point}`.

point.description: Confirmed block height (`840000`) or UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

HeightOrDate.description: A confirmed point of the chain: a block height (`840000`) or a UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_outputs_live
tool.title: Live output value histogram
tool.description:
Live unfiltered output value histogram for the complete published mempool. Nonzero outputs within the histogram's bin range are counted by value on the oracle log scale; no oracle payment filters are applied. A flat array of log-scale bins, all zero when no mempool is configured.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/outputs/live`.

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_payments
tool.title: Payment output histogram at height or day
tool.description:
Smoothed histogram of oracle-eligible payment outputs for a confirmed point. A block height (`840000`) gives that block's oracle payment histogram; a calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) gives the average of that day's per-block payment histograms. A flat array of log-scale bins.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/payments/{point}`.

point.description: Confirmed block height (`840000`) or UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

HeightOrDate.description: A confirmed point of the chain: a block height (`840000`) or a UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_payments_live
tool.title: Live payment output histogram
tool.description:
Live smoothed histogram of oracle-eligible payment outputs, binned by output value on the oracle log scale. It combines the committed oracle window with the complete mempool's eligible outputs from a matching chain publication. A flat array of log-scale bins.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/payments/live`.

tool.name: get_pool
tool.title: Mining pool details
tool.description:
Block counts and mining shares by time period for one pool.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}`.

PoolSlug.description: A mining pool's identifier, as written in URLs.

tool.name: get_pool_blocks
tool.title: Mining pool blocks
tool.description:
Get up to 100 recent blocks mined by a specific pool.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}/blocks`.

PoolSlug.description: A mining pool's identifier, as written in URLs.

tool.name: get_pool_blocks_from_height
tool.title: Mining pool blocks before height
tool.description:
Get up to 100 blocks mined by a specific pool strictly below the given height (pass the last height of a page to get the next one).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}/blocks/{height}`.

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

PoolSlug.description: A mining pool's identifier, as written in URLs.

tool.name: get_pool_hashrate
tool.title: Mining pool hashrate
tool.description:
Get hashrate history for a specific mining pool.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-hashrate)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}/hashrate`.

PoolSlug.description: A mining pool's identifier, as written in URLs.

tool.name: get_pool_ranking
tool.title: Mining pool statistics
tool.description:
Get mining pool statistics for a time period.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pools)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pools/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_pools
tool.title: List all mining pools
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pools)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pools`.

tool.name: get_pools_hashrate
tool.title: All pools hashrate (all time)
tool.description:
Get weekly hashrate data, over the whole chain, of the mining pools that mined in the last week, by time and then their weekly rank.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-hashrates)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate/pools`.

tool.name: get_pools_hashrate_by_period
tool.title: All pools hashrate
tool.description:
Get weekly hashrate data, for a time period, of the mining pools that mined in the last week, by time and then their weekly rank.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-hashrates)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate/pools/{time_period}`.

tool.name: get_precise_fees
tool.title: Recommended fee rates (precise)
tool.description:
Recommended fee rates by confirmation target, with up to three decimal places and support for sub-sat/vB rates.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-recommended-fees-precise)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/fees/precise`.

tool.name: get_prices
tool.title: Current BTC price
tool.description:
Returns bitcoin latest price (on-chain derived, USD only).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-price)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/prices`.

tool.name: get_replacements
tool.title: Recent RBF replacements
tool.description:
Returns up to 25 most-recent RBF replacement trees across the whole mempool. Each entry has the shape of `replacements` in `GET /api/v1/tx/{txid}/rbf`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-replacements)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/replacements`.

tool.name: get_reward_stats
tool.title: Mining reward statistics
tool.description:
Get mining reward statistics for the last N blocks including total rewards, fees, and transaction count.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-reward-stats)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/reward-stats/{block_count}`.

block_count.description: Number of recent blocks to include

tool.name: get_series
tool.title: Get series data
tool.description:
Rows selected by a range of positions, dates or timestamps, as JSON or CSV.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}`.

start.description: Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end.

end.description: Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end.

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return; with `end` too, the tighter of the two applies. Omitted, the rest of the range.

Index.description: Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year), block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

Limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; each parameter states what omitting it means.

RangeIndex.description: A positional index, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

tool.name: get_series_bulk
tool.title: Bulk series data
tool.description:
Fetch multiple series in a single request. Supports filtering by index and date range. Returns an array of SeriesData objects. For a single series, use `get_series` instead.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/bulk`.

start.description: Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end.

end.description: Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end.

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return; with `end` too, the tighter of the two applies. Omitted, the rest of the range.

Index.description: Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year), block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

Limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; each parameter states what omitting it means.

RangeIndex.description: A positional index, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

SeriesList.description:
Comma-separated list of series names

Deserialization permits at most 32 normalized names and 2,048 decoded input
string bytes. For arrays, the byte budget is shared by their string values.

tool.name: get_series_count
tool.title: Series count
tool.description:
Returns the number of series available per index type.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/count`.

tool.name: get_series_info
tool.title: Get series info
tool.description:
Returns the optional description, supported indexes, the indexes whose values can be null, the value type, and the optional unit (what the value type measures) for the specified series. The decoded series name is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}`.

tool.name: get_series_latest
tool.title: Get latest series value
tool.description:
Returns the single most recent value for a series, unwrapped (not inside a SeriesData object).

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}/latest`.

Index.description: Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year), block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

tool.name: get_series_len
tool.title: Get series data length
tool.description:
Get series data length

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}/len`.

Index.description: Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year), block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

tool.name: get_series_version
tool.title: Get series version
tool.description:
Returns the vector's schema/computation version, not its length or latest update. Appends and reorgs do not by themselves change this version.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}/version`.

Index.description: Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year), block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

tool.name: get_sync_status
tool.title: Sync status
tool.description:
Returns a coherent local index snapshot and a separately observed Bitcoin Core tip height. The two heights can differ during indexing or a reorg. Conditional requests refresh these observations before validation.

REST operation: `GET /api/server/sync`.

tool.name: get_transaction_times
tool.title: Transaction first-seen times
tool.description:
First-seen UNIX timestamps in seconds, in request order, of transactions in the mempool or that recently left it other than by replacement (mined ones included); 0 otherwise.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-times)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/transaction-times`.

txids.description: Transaction IDs to look up (max 100 per request).

tool.name: get_tx
tool.title: Transaction information
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction)*

REST operation: `GET /api/tx/{txid}`.

tool.name: get_tx_hex
tool.title: Transaction hex
tool.description:
Hex-encoded serialized transaction.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-hex)*

REST operation: `GET /api/tx/{txid}/hex`.

tool.name: get_tx_merkle_proof
tool.title: Transaction merkle proof
tool.description:
*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-merkle-proof)*

REST operation: `GET /api/tx/{txid}/merkle-proof`.

tool.name: get_tx_merkleblock_proof

Get the merkleblock proof for a transaction (BIP37 format, hex encoded).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-merkleblock-proof)*

tool.name: get_tx_outspend

Whether the output has been spent and, if so, the spending transaction details. An output no known transaction holds is unspent.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-outspend)*

tool.name: get_tx_outspends

Spend statuses in output-index order.

tool.name: get_tx_rbf

Returns the RBF replacement tree for a transaction, if any. Both `replacements` and `replaces` are null when the tx has no known RBF history within the mempool monitor's retention window.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-rbf-history)*

tool.name: get_tx_status

tool.name: get_txid_by_index

index.description: Global transaction index across the chain

TxIndex.description:
Chain-wide transaction index (0 = the genesis coinbase). For an
in-block position, use `BlockTxIndex` instead.

tool.name: get_urpd
tool.title: URPD at block height or date
tool.description:
URPD for a cohort at a block height or the last block of a UTC day. Returns `{ height, hash, date, cohort, weight, aggregation, close, supply, buckets }` where `buckets` is columns, `{ price, supply, realized_cap, unrealized_pnl }`, one entry per bucket in ascending price: the same block header and columnar layout as `GET /api/utxo-set/{point}`. `close`, `price`, `realized_cap`, and `unrealized_pnl` are USD; `supply` is BTC. `unrealized_pnl` can be negative. Bucket `realized_cap` and `unrealized_pnl` value each coin at its creation price on the price grid (four significant digits of the price in cents, within 0.05% of the exact price), rounded to the cent per bucket, so the buckets need not sum to the realized cap series. With a `wakefulness` or `mobility` `weight`, `supply` is the weighted supply (whole satoshis) and the bucket values follow it.

REST operation: `GET /api/urpd/{cohort}/{point}`.

point.description: Confirmed block height (`840000`) or UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

HeightOrDate.description: A confirmed point of the chain: a block height (`840000`) or a UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

UrpdAggregation.description:
Aggregation strategy for URPD buckets.
Options: raw (no aggregation), lin200/lin500/lin1000 (linear $200/$500/$1000),
log10/log50/log100/log200/log500/log1000/log2000 (logarithmic with 10/50/100/200/500/1000/2000 buckets per decade).

UrpdCohort.description: A URPD cohort, by its series' prefix: an age aggregate (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...) or an age band (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

UrpdWeight.description:
The weight applied to a URPD's age bands: `none` (every satoshi counts once), `wakefulness` (each band
weighted by the share of its coin days already consumed, Cointime's; the distribution behind the
`*_awake_*` series) or `mobility` (each band weighted by the estimated probability its coins are ever
spent, Coinflow's; behind `*_mobile_*`).

tool.name: get_urpd_latest
tool.title: Latest URPD
tool.description:
URPD for the latest published block; `date` echoes the date served. Fields, units, price-grid rounding and weighting as in `GET /api/urpd/{cohort}/{point}`.

REST operation: `GET /api/urpd/{cohort}`.

UrpdAggregation.description:
Aggregation strategy for URPD buckets.
Options: raw (no aggregation), lin200/lin500/lin1000 (linear $200/$500/$1000),
log10/log50/log100/log200/log500/log1000/log2000 (logarithmic with 10/50/100/200/500/1000/2000 buckets per decade).

UrpdCohort.description: A URPD cohort, by its series' prefix: an age aggregate (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...) or an age band (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

UrpdWeight.description:
The weight applied to a URPD's age bands: `none` (every satoshi counts once), `wakefulness` (each band
weighted by the share of its coin days already consumed, Cointime's; the distribution behind the
`*_awake_*` series) or `mobility` (each band weighted by the estimated probability its coins are ever
spent, Coinflow's; behind `*_mobile_*`).

tool.name: get_utxo_set_diff
tool.title: UTXO set changes of a block or date
tool.description:
What a block (`840000`) or a UTC day's published blocks (`YYYY-MM-DD`) changed in the UTXO set. Returns `{ first, last, hash, date, created, spent }`: `created` has one row per block, `spent` one row per creation height, each as columnar `height`, `count` and `supply` (BTC). The set after block `first - 1` plus `created` minus `spent` is the set after block `last`.

REST operation: `GET /api/utxo-set/{point}/diff`.

point.description: Confirmed block height (`840000`) or UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`)

Height.description: A block height: how many blocks came before it.

HeightOrDate.description: A confirmed point of the chain: a block height (`840000`) or a UTC calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

tool.name: list_indexes
tool.title: List available indexes
tool.description:
Returns every index a series can be read at, by the name series routes take.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/indexes`.

tool.name: list_series
tool.title: Series list
tool.description:
Paginated flat list of all available series names.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/list`.

tool.name: list_urpd_cohorts
tool.title: Available URPD cohorts
tool.description:
Every URPD cohort once a UTXO set is published (none before): the age aggregates (`all`, `sth`, `lth`, `age_under_4m`, ...), then the age bands from the youngest (`age_under_1h`, `age_1h_to_1d`, ...).

REST operation: `GET /api/urpd`.

tool.name: search_series
tool.title: Search series
tool.description:
Search series by name or descriptive terms. Results prioritize whole query words in names, then descriptions, then fuzzy names, then fuzzy descriptions. Word order does not matter. Descriptions provide cohort terminology and formulas. The decoded q parameter is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/search`.

q.description: Words to find in series names and descriptions (`realized price`, `mvrv`), in any order

tool.name: validate_address
tool.title: Validate address
tool.description:
Validate a Bitcoin address and get information about its type and scriptPubKey. Returns `isvalid: false` with an error message for invalid addresses; a string that isn't 2 to 130 letters and digits answers 400.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-validate)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/validate-address/{address}`.

address.description:
Bitcoin address to validate: 2 to 130 letters and digits (a P2PK public key in hex is 130);
anything else answers 400, as mempool.space does
